lines: Lines can repeat now—every day, weekdays, days you pick, or monthly—and "Not today" moves one to tomorrow. Both live in the line's own menu.

Sound sticks on the iPhone after a call or a lock. Three new sound packs, one-thing mode (press O or tap the count), search in Everything, templates, a Recently deleted shelf, and a URL that adds a line from anywhere.
Settings has a home now: ⋯ → Settings. Deleting a list everywhere is at the bottom of ⋯, with ten seconds to change your mind.
Every list is encrypted on your device before it goes anywhere. The link is the key; a view link lets someone watch without touching.
Fonts and the realtime client are served from this site—nothing loads from Google or a CDN—and the phone menu became a proper bottom sheet.
A five-step tour on the first list, and a save-your-link sheet you can't miss.
Sync between devices through a secret link, no account. Sections and several lists; Everything holds the backlog.
Twelve curated themes plus your own from one accent colour, each with its own fonts, sounds and confetti. Installable on the phone and the Mac.
Five lines in big type, a strike that draws across, a knock or a bell, confetti, and a finale when the list is done.
